posts.title: Rusty Martin, Presente!
posts.description: I was deeply saddened to learn of the recent death of my friend and comrade in resistance to registration for a military draft in the USA, Rusty Martin. Rusty lived his life on his own terms. Diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's Disease in 2024, he ended his life on his own terms on 18 August 2026. posts.title: Poll: Bipartisan opposition to a military draft
posts.description: A new poll by Overton Insights shows the breadth and depth of opposition to a military draft -- and how far members of Congress lag behind popular anti-draft (and anti-war) sentiment. Almost all categories of Americans who were polled would oppose a draft.
